en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4482 - Al-Alaa narrated from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:

I asked him about a man who has two wives, one of whom is more beloved to him than the other. Imam (as) said: "He may spend three nights with her and one night with the other. However, if he wishes to marry four wives, then each wife is entitled to one night. Therefore, it is permissible for him to prefer some of them over others as long as they are not four."
